minimum_used_basis: Two canonical session openings already charged on the same existing grant; current state/counts must be reviewed. No duplicate grant appended.

canonical_constraints: available grant with1 action blocks issue; insufficient-for-two is not expired/exhausted.
New grant does not migrate an existing session. Do not spend the last action then assume same-session continuation can use a replacement.
After natural expiry, obtain canonical review showing no available matching grant/can_issue true; root selects exact CAS request before recover/issue once.
Preserve all historical grants and consumed actions. No revoke, manual reset, forced exhaustion or setup:test.
Review/report insufficient balance distinctly, without substituting canonical state. If unexpectedly available, remain observation-only and require a later explicit canonical review; no POST replay.
grant_plan.minimum_helper_delta: Refresh pinned grant history/current counts; retain existing balance>=2 and requestcap3. Recognize insufficient available balance as a reported blocked selection, never bypass can_issue; planned path waits for expiry and reuses canonical review/recover/issue.
